name: Sylvan Library
oracle_text: At the beginning of your draw step, you may draw two additional cards. If you do, choose two cards in your hand drawn this turn. For each of those cards, pay 4 life or put the card on top of your library.
blocked_sentences: If you do, choose two cards in your hand drawn this turn.

needs.what: A selector key that narrows a zone to the cards that were drawn this turn -- e.g. `drawn_this_turn: true` on `{"zone": "hand", "player": "you", "count": 2}` -- backed by a per-object record of the turn on which a card was drawn, written where every draw already funnels through (`replacements._draw_one` / `replacements.draw`, the same place miracle and dredge hook). Nothing else on this card is missing: the trigger is `draw_step`, the optional two extra draws are `may` + `draw`, and the per-card cost-or-consequence is a `for_each` over the chosen binding whose body is `may` with `pay: {"pay_life": 4}` and `else: [put_on_top {objects: {binding: "each"}}]` -- the shipped Mystic Remora idiom. Only the pool that `for_each` iterates cannot be built.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The nearest thing in `reference` is the value `cards_drawn_this_turn`, but it is a per-player integer tally (`GameState.cards_drawn_this_turn`, cleared each turn) with no record of which cards those were, so it can size an amount and never name an object. No key in `selector_keys` filters a card by how or when it reached a zone: `arrived_this_turn_from` is not a selector key at all (it is a static-ability field read only by `graveyard_cast_arrival_ok`, and it asks about a graveyard, not a hand), and `GameObject` tracks `entered_turn`, `graveyard_turn` and `graveyard_from` but has no field for a draw. The `draw` op's `as` binding is documented as recording the player seats that drew, not the drawn card objects, so there is no binding to hand to `for_each` either -- and it would in any case be the wrong set, since the printed line is every card drawn this turn, including the normal draw-step draw and any drawn before Sylvan Library's trigger.
